rules.note: Winter window opens 1 January and closes within three days of 31 January (Rule V.3); bench of nine, five substitutions (Rule L.29); squad list of 25, at most 17 not home-grown (A.1.283).

players.n: Jarzinho Ataide Adriano de Nascimento Malanga

ic.note: Format from the 2025 regulations (art. 4): M1 CAF v OFC, M2 AFC v winner of M1 (home grounds, hosts alternate yearly), M3 Concacaf v CONMEBOL, M4 winner of M3 v winner of M2, M5 UEFA v winner of M4 (neutral). 2026: the first two matches' clubs and dates from Transfermarkt (their results are not used: the game replays the season); the December dates follow 2025's (10, 13, 17 December), a year on.
